subkind.description: Indicates the content of this message

player.description: The player who initiated this event

card.description: The card associated with this event (See card_schema.json)

row.description: The board row affected (close, ranged, siege)

target_player.description: The player whose board the card was placed on (for spy cards)

reason.description: Why a card was removed (scorch, scorch_ability, decoy, round_end)

weather_rows.description: Current active weather rows after change

returned_card.description: Card returned to hand by decoy swap

score.description: The calculated score for update_score events

gems.description: The remaining gems for update_gems events

active_turn.description: Whether it is this player's turn
